units.crm-cskh-healthcheck.service:
[Unit]
Description=CRM-CSKH Periodic Technical Health, Backup Freshness & Business Invariants Probe (External Alerts Gated)
After=docker.service
Requires=docker.service

[Service]
Type=oneshot
User=root
Group=root
UMask=0077
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 /opt/crm-cskh-ops/deploy/ops/check_health_and_invariants.py --env-file /opt/crm-cskh-staging/.env.staging --mode tls --extra-compose-file /opt/crm-cskh-staging/compose.domain.yaml --site crm-staging.localhost --environment-label staging --backup-status-file /var/backups/crm-cskh/latest-backup-lifecycle.json --max-backup-age-hours 26.0 --alert-log-file /var/lib/crm-cskh/health/health-alerts.jsonl --out /var/lib/crm-cskh/health/latest-health-report.json
units.crm-cskh-healthcheck.timer:
[Unit]
Description=Run CRM-CSKH Health & Invariants Probe Periodically

[Timer]
OnCalendar=*:0/5
RandomizedDelaySec=20
Persistent=true
Unit=crm-cskh-healthcheck.service

[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target
units.crm-cskh-backup.service:
[Unit]
Description=CRM-CSKH Daily Encrypted Backup + Checksum + GFS Retention
After=docker.service
Requires=docker.service
OnFailure=crm-cskh-backup-failure@%n.service

[Service]
Type=oneshot
User=root
Group=root
UMask=0077
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 /opt/crm-cskh-ops/deploy/ops/manage_backup_lifecycle.py run-scheduled --compose-wrapper /opt/crm-cskh-staging/staging-compose --site crm-staging.localhost --backup-root /var/backups/crm-cskh --environment-label staging --keep-daily 14 --keep-weekly 8 --keep-monthly 3
units.crm-cskh-backup-failure@.service:
[Unit]
Description=CRM-CSKH Backup Failure Alert Recorder (External Delivery Gated)

[Service]
Type=oneshot
User=root
Group=root
UMask=0077
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 /opt/crm-cskh-ops/deploy/ops/manage_backup_lifecycle.py emit-failure-alert --backup-root /var/backups/crm-cskh --environment-label staging --unit-name %i --reason 'systemd unit %i exited non-zero'
units.crm-cskh-backup.timer:
[Unit]
Description=Run CRM-CSKH Daily Encrypted Backup

[Timer]
OnCalendar=*-*-* 19:15:00 UTC
RandomizedDelaySec=120
Persistent=true
Unit=crm-cskh-backup.service

[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target
